make_sim: create a Habitat simulator instance by name using the registry and pass kwargs to its constructor
review_make_sim: review the make_sim function that looks up a simulator from the registry and instantiates it
summarize_make_sim: summarize the make_sim function which retrieves a registered simulator class and calls it with kwargs
test_make_sim: test the make_sim function to ensure it raises an assertion when the simulator name is not found
refactor_make_sim: refactor the make_sim function to return a more descriptive error instead of a bare assertion
